svg.title: CIE 1931 2-degree xy chromaticity diagram
svg.desc: Spectral locus computed from the CIE 1931 2-degree standard observer colour matching functions (380-700 nm, 1 nm). Same canvas and axis frame for 1931 and 1964, so points are placed with the same CIE xy to SVG mapping. Fill colours are an sRGB approximation.
